notes: The AR-133 is a passive-input, active/transformer-output DI box (direct box) / line balancer, not a rack device (desktop/stage floor unit, 145x125x59mm, ~650g) — rackUnits omitted. All I/O is analog audio, so no connector carries a bandwidth "grade" per the SDI/HDMI/DP/USB/Ethernet scales; grade is omitted on every port. No separate AC/DC power inlet exists to list as a power port: the unit is powered either by phantom power delivered through the 3-pin XLR Output connector (already listed, +20 to +48VDC, <8mA) or by an internal 9V PP3 battery (not a connector), with automatic failover between the two — this is noted on the output port rather than modeled as a separate power connector, since none of the allowed power-connector ids (nema-5-15/iec/iec-c7/iec-c19/dc-barrel/xlr4-dc/powercon) apply. Extracted directly from BSS Audio's official AR-133 User Manual PDF (part number ZM0199-01), hosted on Harman Professional's official ADN documents server (bssaudio.com's support/downloads page links to the same file); also cross-checked against the manufacturer's bssaudio.com product/spec content. Category was set to "audio" (broad audio-equipment bucket) with type "Converter" since a DI box's core function is level/impedance conversion of an unbalanced instrument signal to a balanced mic-level feed — no more specific type in the provided enum fits.

ports.name: Input 1/4" Jack
ports.note: Unbalanced, tip hot / sleeve ground; main instrument input, feeding a switchable 0dB/-20dB/-40dB pad

ports.name: 3-pin XLR Socket
ports.note: Unbalanced, wired in parallel with the 1/4" input jack; pin 2 hot, pins 1 & 3 ground

ports.name: Link 1/4" Jack
ports.note: Parallel feed from the input (direct, or via optional internal buffer amp) for simultaneously feeding an instrument amplifier; tip hot, sleeve ground

ports.name: 3-pin XLR Output
ports.note: Transformer-balanced console output, drives 600 ohm+ loads; also the point where +20 to +48VDC phantom power is received to power the unit
